data.title: How It Works
items: Take a 5-minute break when timer ends
After 4 Pomodoros, take a longer 15-30 min break
data.footnote: Developed by Francesco Cirillo in the 1980s

data.myth: You need hours of uninterrupted time to study effectively
data.fact: Short, focused bursts with breaks are more productive than marathon sessions
data.proof: Studies show focused 25-min intervals improve retention by up to 30%

data.subtext: Follow for daily study hacks and productivity tips
